crossRefs.note: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to…

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

people.name: Zippor
people.line: Father of Balak, king of Moab

translations.web: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.
translations.bsb: Then Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying: “Arise, O Balak, and listen; give ear to me, O son of Zippor.
translations.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
translations.asv: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; Hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
